_doc: Names that MUST NOT appear as a `spec/verbs/<name>.json` file or as a verb's `name` field. Three categories: v1 verbs that were renamed into the v2 dotted-namespace convention; v1 verbs whose capability was deliberately dropped from v2; and v2.0 dotted-lowercase names superseded by v2.1 renames. Enforced by tests/check_spec.py. The v1-drops table in spec/AUTHORING-PROGRESS.md carries the long-form rationale for the dropped capabilities.

reserved.name: MPOS
reserved.reason: Cursor-position query was dropped: trivially derivable client-side via GetCursorPos. See v1-drops table in spec/AUTHORING-PROGRESS.md.

reserved.name: SCREEN
reserved.reason: Screen-dimensions query was dropped: subsumed by system.info.monitors. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: MOVEREL
reserved.reason: Relative cursor movement was dropped: clients compose via current-position read + absolute input.move. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: DCLICK
reserved.reason: Double-click primitive was dropped: composable from input.click. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: MDOWN
reserved.reason: Mouse-down primitive was dropped: composable from input.click. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: MUP
reserved.reason: Mouse-up primitive was dropped: composable from input.click. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: DRAG
reserved.reason: Drag primitive was dropped: composable from input.click + input.move. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: KEYDOWN
reserved.reason: Key-hold primitive was dropped: v2 input.key is single-fire. RawInput / DirectInput limitation makes wire-layer hold semantics unreachable anyway. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: KEYUP
reserved.reason: Key-release primitive was dropped: same rationale as KEYDOWN. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: IDLE
reserved.reason: User-input idle-time query was dropped: never-substantiated use-case. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: DRIVES
reserved.reason: Filesystem-root list was dropped: subsumable under directory.list. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: ENV
reserved.reason: Environment-variable read was dropped: composable via process.start. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: ABORT
reserved.reason: Global cancel-all-verbs was dropped: cross-connection cancellation is a DoS vector. v2 watch.cancel is subscription-scoped only. See v1-drops table.

reserved.name: WAITFOR
reserved.reason: Combined wait-on-screen / wait-on-file was dropped: v2 splits cleanly into file.wait and watch.region --until-change. See v1-drops table.
